title: Tesserae view
description: A Tesserae view: `*_View.yaml`. One node, with its children inside it.

color.description: A theme role (such as `surface` or `on_primary`), `#RGB`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`, `transparent`, a CSS colour name, or a CSS function such as `rgb(...)` or `oklch(...)`. End any of them with `@N%` to scale its alpha: `primary@12%`.

stops.description: Colours, or `[place, colour]` pairs with places from 0 to 1.

center.description: `[x, y]`, as fractions of the box.

anyOf.description: A CSS-like `linear-gradient(...)`, `radial-gradient(...)` or `conic-gradient(...)` whose stops are theme roles or colours, or a mapping with `gradient: linear|radial|sweep` and `stops`.

fill.description: A colour (a theme role, a hex or a CSS colour) or a gradient.

style.description: How a node looks and lays out its children.

align_cells.description: In a grid: where each item sits in its cell. (Grid.)

align_content.description: Where its children sit: `top_left`, `top`, `top_right`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `bottom_left`, `bottom` or `bottom_right`. Not set, they fill the space across the layout. (Alignment.)

align_self.description: Its own place in its parent, over the parent's `align_content`. (Alignment.)

align_tracks.description: In a grid: how the tracks share the room left over. (Grid.)

align_wrapped.description: With `flex_wrap: wrap`: how the lines share the room left over. (Alignment.)

aspect_ratio.description: Width over height: gives the missing side from the one set. (Size and spacing.)

backdrop_blur.description: Blurs what is behind it, by this many pixels: with a translucent `background`, a frosted surface. (Paint and effects.)

background.description: Its fill: a theme role such as `surface`, `#RRGGBB`, any CSS colour, or a gradient such as `linear-gradient(90deg, primary, tertiary)`. (Paint and effects.)

blend_mode.description: How it is drawn over what is behind it, as CSS `mix-blend-mode`. (Paint and effects.)

blur.description: Blurs the node and what it draws, by this many pixels. (Paint and effects.)

border_color.description: The colour of its border: a colour or a gradient. (Paint and effects.)

border_width.description: The width of its border, in pixels. (Paint and effects.)

clip_children.description: Whether children are cut off at its edge. (Paint and effects.)

top_left.description: The radius of the top left corner.

top_right.description: The radius of the top right corner.

bottom_right.description: The radius of the bottom right corner.

bottom_left.description: The radius of the bottom left corner.

top.description: The radius of both top corners.

right.description: The radius of both right corners.

bottom.description: The radius of both bottom corners.

left.description: The radius of both left corners.

corner_radius.description: Pixels, or a shape token (`none` to `extra_large`, or `full` for a pill or circle). Per corner: a list `[top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left]`, or a mapping of corners and edges (`top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`) with the rest square. (Paint and effects.)

src.description: A PNG (or any picture Pillow reads) next to the view.

hotspot.description: `[x, y]`: the pixel that is the pointer's place.

cursor.description: The pointer over it: a name, or `{src: cursor.png, hotspot: [x, y]}` (a picture next to the view, at most 256 pixels a side; only in a node's own `style:`). (Paint and effects.)

elevation.description: A shadow level, 0 to 5. (Paint and effects.)

saturate.description: 1 is unchanged, 0 grey, above 1 more vivid.

contrast.description: 1 is unchanged, 0 flat grey, above 1 harder.

filter.description: Colour filters over it and its children, as in CSS: `{grayscale: 1}`, `{saturate: 0.4, brightness: 0.9}` (`hue_rotate` is in degrees). (Paint and effects.)

flex.description: How it takes room in its parent: `none` (the default) is as big as its content and never squeezed, `expand_horizontal` and `expand_vertical` take the room left over in that direction, `fill` both. (Flex.)

flex_direction.description: How its children are laid out: `horizontal` (the default) or `vertical`. (Flex.)

flex_wrap.description: `wrap` lets children flow onto more lines; `no_wrap` keeps one. (Flex.)

foreground.description: Its text or glyph colour: a theme role, `#RRGGBB`, any CSS colour, or a gradient. (Paint and effects.)

grid_auto_columns.description: The size of columns the template doesn't name. (Grid.)

grid_auto_flow.description: How grid children fill the cells. (Grid.)

grid_auto_rows.description: The size of rows the template doesn't name. (Grid.)

grid_column.description: Which grid column it takes: `2`, or `1 / 3`. (Grid.)

grid_row.description: Which grid row it takes: `2`, or `1 / 3`. (Grid.)

grid_template_columns.description: The grid's columns, as in CSS: `1fr 2fr 100px`. (Grid.)

grid_template_rows.description: The grid's rows, as in CSS. (Grid.)

height.description: Pixels, `auto` (its content's size, or stretched), or a percentage of the parent such as `50%`. (Size and spacing.)

margin.description: Space outside it: one number, or `{left, right, top, bottom}`. (Size and spacing.)

max_height.description: The most height it can take. (Size and spacing.)

max_width.description: The most width it can take. (Size and spacing.)

min_height.description: The least height it can take. (Size and spacing.)

min_width.description: The least width it can take. (Size and spacing.)

padding.description: Space inside it: one number, or `{left, right, top, bottom}`. (Size and spacing.)

position.description: `absolute` takes it out of the flow and places it at `x` and `y`. (Position.)

rotation_deg.description: Turns the node by this many degrees, clockwise, about its centre. (Motion.)

scale.description: Draws the node and what is in it at this multiple of its size (1 is unchanged), about its centre. (Motion.)

spread.description: Spreads its children along the layout: `between` (the space goes between them), `around` or `evenly`. (Alignment.)

sticky.description: In a scroll view, it sticks this many pixels from the top edge as its siblings scroll past. (Position.)

transition.description: Which style changes ease to their new value: a duration in milliseconds, or `{duration, easing, bounce}`. `all` covers every one that can. A node is where it says when first drawn; only a change eases. (Motion.)

translate_x.description: Draws the node this many pixels to the right of where it is laid out. (Motion.)

translate_y.description: Draws the node this many pixels lower than where it is laid out. (Motion.)

width.description: Pixels, `auto` (its content's size, or stretched), or a percentage of the parent such as `50%`. (Size and spacing.)

x.description: Where an `absolute` node sits from the left. (Position.)

y.description: Where an `absolute` node sits from the top. (Position.)

z_index.description: Stacking order: higher is in front. (Position.)

zone.description: A DockPanel's zone in its Dock: where it docks. Only a DockPanel directly in a Dock has one; anywhere else it is an error. (Docking.)

text.description: What a Text, Link or TextField says, and in what type.

typography_role.description: A Material 3 type style: it sets the font, size, weight and line height.

text_align.description: Where the text sits in its node's width; a `center` or `end` Text with no width fills its parent's. Not for a TextField.

wrap.description: `word` (the default) breaks a line that is too long for its node onto the next; `none` keeps one line. Not for a TextField.

selectable.description: A Text only: the user can select it with the pointer and copy it (Ctrl+C).

runs.description: A Text only: the text as styled pieces, instead of `content`. A piece is a string, or `{text, color, weight, italic, underline, strikethrough, font_size, font_family, link}`. A piece with a `link` is `primary` and underlined, and a click on it calls `on_link` with `event.href`.

color.description: Its colour: a theme role or a CSS colour.

link.description: Makes it a link: what `on_link` hears as `event.href`.

overflow.description: What happens to a line that doesn't fit its node: `clip` (the default) cuts it off, `ellipsis` ends it with an ellipsis. Not for a TextField.

max_lines.description: The most lines shown; a longer text is cut there (with `overflow: ellipsis`, the last line ends with an ellipsis). A Text with a width and no height is as tall as these lines. Not for a TextField.

letter_spacing.description: Extra space between letters, in pixels (tracking); negative tightens. Not for a TextField.

handlers.description: What a user's action calls: the name of a ViewModel method, or `window.<action>`.

on_click.description: Runs on `click`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_hover_enter.description: Runs on `pointer_enter`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_hover_exit.description: Runs on `pointer_leave`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_change.description: Runs on `change`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_focus_enter.description: Runs on `focus`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_focus_exit.description: Runs on `unfocus`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_tap.description: Runs on `tap`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_long_press.description: Runs on `long_press`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_pan.description: Runs on `pan`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_pinch.description: Runs on `pinch`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_touch_start.description: Runs on `touch_start`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_touch_move.description: Runs on `touch_move`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_touch_end.description: Runs on `touch_end`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_touch_cancel.description: Runs on `touch_cancel`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_file_hover.description: Runs on `file_hover`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_file_hover_cancel.description: Runs on `file_hover_cancel`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_file_drop.description: Runs on `file_drop`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

on_link.description: Runs on `link`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`, `surface.dismiss`, `navigate.<Screen>`, `navigate.back`, `navigate.forward`.

a11y.description: What assistive technology is told about this node.

label.description: The name a screen reader says.

role.description: What kind of thing it is.

live.description: How changes to it are announced.

expanded.description: Open or closed, on something that opens and closes.

pressed.description: A toggle button's state: true, false or `mixed`.

description.description: A longer description than the label.

describedby.description: The `name:` of a node in this view that describes this one, or a list.

controls.description: The `name:` of a node in this view that this one controls, or a list.

current.description: The current item of a set: `page`, `step`, `location`, `date`, `time` or true.

value_text.description: How a range's value is said.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

classes.description: Style classes a theme or stylesheet rule can match.

anyOf.description: A `*_Style.yaml` file next to this one.

style.description: How a node looks: a mapping, or the name of a `*_Style.yaml` file.

min.description: The least a Slider or SpinBox takes.

max.description: The most a Slider or SpinBox takes.

step.description: How far a Slider or SpinBox moves.

src.description: An image file, relative to this one.

fit.description: How it fills its box: `cover` (the default), `contain`, ...

svg.description: An Svg's document: a file, or its text.

src.description: An SVG file (`.svg` or `.svgz`), relative to this view. The pictures it refers to are decoded and found next to it.

content.description: The SVG document itself, as text.

draw.description: Commands painted in order: `rect: [x, y, w, h]`, `circle: [cx, cy, r]` or `path: [points]` (with `width`), each with a `color`.

offset.description: How far it is scrolled, in pixels.

virtual.description: A VirtualList's length: how many rows there are, and how tall each is.

count.description: How many rows the list has.

extent.description: How tall each row is, in pixels.

modal.description: Whether the layer is a scrim over the whole window.

path.description: SVG path data, instead of a name.

view_box.description: [min_x, min_y, width, height] the path is drawn in (default 0 -960 960 960).

bindings.description: Properties kept live from the ViewModel: `{{ expression }}`.

two_way.description: The one bound property whose user edits write back to the ViewModel.

interaction.description: A Rect or Container's hover, press and focus feedback: `true`, `false`, or `{color: ...}`.

group.description: A RadioButton's group: the ones with one name exclude each other.

component_of.description: The fragment this node is the root of.

disabled.description: Whether the node ignores input and fades.

window_region.description: `drag`: a press here moves the window (a title bar); `none`: it does not.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

icon.description: An icon name, shown before the title.

buttons.description: Which window buttons, in order: minimize, maximize, close (all by default); or just `dismiss`, a button that closes the dialog or sheet the bar is in.

view_node.description: Another view shown here: `view: Left_View.yaml` (or a name found in the project). It is a view of its own, with its own ids and its own ViewModel if it has one (`Left_ViewModel.py`); one with none is static.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

view.description: The view to show: a `*_View.yaml` next to this file, or a name found in the project.

with.description: What the embedded view's ViewModel is given, as keyword arguments to its constructor.

route.description: In the window view, makes the view a screen of the app: its route, such as `""`, `settings` or `notes/{id}`. A view can be routed once.

window_node.description: The OS window: the root of a view (there is one per app). Its `title_bar:` is the window's title bar, its `children` are the window's content, and `style:`'s `width` and `height` are the window's size.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

borderless.description: The OS window has no title bar or borders of its own: the `title_bar:` is the window's.
